s: jakAraH । sa vyaYjanAzwamavarRaH । cavargatftIyavarRaSca । asyoccAraRasTAnaM tAlu । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (yaduktaM sidDAntakOmudyAm । “icu yaSAnAM tAlu .” taTAca SikzAyAm । “kaRWyAvahAvicuyaSAstAlavyA ozWajAvupU ॥”) asyotpattiryaTA, prapaYcasAre । “visargastAlugaH sozmA SaM cavargaYca yantaTA ॥” (vaNgAkzareRa) asya leKanaprakAro yaTA, varRodDAratantre । “UrdDvADaHkuYcitA reKA tAsu brahmeSasaMviBuH । vAgdevI kamalA nityA dbiDA mAtrA prakIrttitA ॥” asya svarUpaM yaTA, kAmaDenutantre । “jakAraM parameSAni ! yA svayaM maDyakuRqalI । SaraccandrapratIkASaM sadA triguRasaMyutam ॥ paYcadevamayaM varRaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA । triSaktisahitaM varRaM tribindusahitaM priye ! ॥” tasya DyAnaM yaTA, varRodDAratantre । “DyAnamasyAH pravakzyAmi SfRuzva kamalAnane ! । nAnAlaNkArasaMyuktErBujErdvAdaSaBiryutAm ॥ raktacandanadigDANgIM vicitrAmbaraDAriRIm । trilocanAM jagadDAtrIM varadAM BaktavatsalAm ॥ evaM DyAtvA brahmarUpAM tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” tasya paryyAyA yaTA, -- “jaH Savo vAnaraH SUlI BogadA vijayA sTirA laladevo jayo jetA DAtakI sumuKI viBuH ॥ lambodarI smftiH SAKA supraBA karttfkADarA । dIrGabAhU rucirhaMso nandI tejAH surADipaH ॥ javano vegito vAmo mAnavAkzaH sadAtmakaH । hfnmAruteSvaro vegI cAmodo madavihvalaH ॥” iti nAnAtantram ॥ (DAtupAWe'nubanDaviSezaH । yaTA, kavikalpadrume । “jo jvalAdyo YiradyaktazwuH sATurqustrimakyutaH ॥” CandaHSAstroktamaDyagururgaRaviSezaH । (. v: jakAro vyaYjanavarRaBedaH sparSasaMjYastasyoccAraRasTAnaM tAlu, AByantaraprayatnaH jihvAmavyaBAgena tAlusparSaH vAhyaprayatnASca GozasaMvAranAdAH alpaprARaSca । mAtfkAnyAse'sya vAmamaRibanDe nyAsaH । tantroktA asya vAcakaSabdA yaTA “jaScaturAnanaH SUlI BogI ca vijayA sTirA । baladevo jayo jetA DAtakI sumuKI viBuH । lambodarI smftiH SAKA supaBA karttfkADarA । dIrGabAhUrucirhaMso nandI tejAH surADipaH । javano vegito vAmamaRivanDapadAtmakaH । hfnmAruteSvago veSI cAmodI madavihvalaH” varRRodDAratantram । asya DyeyarUpaM yaTA “jakAraM parameSAni! yA svayaM maDyakuRqalI । SaraccandrapratIkASaM sadA triguRasaMyutam । paYcadevamayaM varRaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA । triSakti sahitaM varRam trivindusahitaM priye!” kAmaDenutantram । kAvye'sya praTamavinyAsaPalaM vftta॰ ra॰ wI॰ uktaM “jomitralABamityAdi” ।

m: 1. ज the 3rd palatal letter (having the sound of j in jump).
2. ज mf(आ)n. (√ जन्) ifc. born or descended from, produced or caused by, born or produced in or at or upon, growing in, living at, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(after an adv. or adverbial word) born or produced (e.g. अग्र-, अवर-; एक-, द्वि-, नि-, पूर्व-, प्रथम-, सह- and साकं-ज), Mn. x, 25
prepared from, made of or with, v, 25; Suśr.; Hcat.
‘belonging to, connected with, peculiar to’, see अनूप, अन्न, शह्र-, सार्थ-.
ज m. a son of (in comp.), Mn. &c.
a: ज — a. [जि-जन्-जु-वा ड] 1 (At the end of comp.) Born from or in, produced or caused by, descended from, growing in, living or being at or in &c.; अत्रिनेत्रज, कुलज, जलज, क्षत्रियज, अंडज, उद्भिज &c. --2 Prepared from, made of. --3 Belonging to, connected with, peculiar to. --4 Swift. --5 Victorious, conquering. --जः 1 A father. --2 Production, birth. --3 Poison. --4 An imp or goblin. --5 A conqueror. --6 Lustre. --7 N. of Viṣṇu. --8 N. of Śiva. --9 Enjoyment. --10 Speed, swiftness. --11 (In prosody) One of the eight syllabic feet (गण).
